items.information: **AOS NOVATOS:** Por favor, enviar um email para [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) ou trazer um documento com foto, data de nascimento e nome completo para fins de completação do processo de registro. **FOR NEWCOMERS:** Please send an email to [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) or bring an ID that contains a photo, date of birth and full name to complete the registration process. Inscrição de competidor: R$ 15,00 A entrada do público será livre. Limite de competidores: 30. Registration fee: R$ 15,00 Guest entry will be free Competitor limit: 30. REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; **Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante;** **Caso não seja informado o nome do competidor, a inscrição NÃO SERÁ ACEITA** Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 30 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com um dos Delegados através do e-mail. **VOCÊ SÓ PODE SE REGISTRAR PARA UMA COMPETIÇÃO NESTA SÉRIE! CASO SE REGISTRE NAS DUAS COMPETIÇÕES, SUA INSCRIÇÃO SERÁ REMOVIDA DA COMPETIÇÃO QUE TIVER MENOS COMPETIDORES** **ATENÇÃO: HAVERÁ INSCRIÇÕES NO DIA, MAS AS VAGAS SÃO LIMITADAS; PORTANTO, PRIORIZE SE INSCREVER O QUANTO ANTES** REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: **Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name;** **If the name of the competitor is not informed, the registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED** Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned There will be a limit of 30 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact one of the Delegates via email. **YOU CAN ONLY REGISTER AT ONE COMPETITION IN THIS SERIES! IF YOU REGISTER IN BOTH COMPETITIONS, YOU'LL HAVE YOUR REGISTRATION REMOVED FROM THE COMPETITION WITH FEWER COMPETITORS** **THERE WILL BE ON THE SPOT REGISTRATION, HOWEVER, THE SPOTS ARE LIMITED; THEREFORE, MAKE SURE YOU REGISTER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE**

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. There are a few qualification requirements for this national championship to maintain smooth running of the competition, please refer to the events tab to see these requirements. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2024 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days. **Sponsored by QY Toys and X-Man Design!** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU2MDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2ce7b99fead9a7064a204589c9e04bc6e4f048a5/image.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU2MDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f752ddc2f5264fdab0365743efe80e6ab99be833/image.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JPIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09f328966024b349b182c10e5943a3983f83b9cd/snz_logo_v06.png) [Website](https://speedcubing.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnz)
